source: POC seed. China statutory public holidays for 2025 as published by the 国务院办公厅 (General Office of the State Council), including the 春节 (Spring Festival) and 国庆/中秋 (National Day) golden weeks. NOTE: China also designates 调休 make-up WORK days on adjacent weekends; those are NOT modelled here (the engine only rolls a deadline forward off a non-working day, so an extra working Saturday cannot pull a deadline earlier and is safe to omit). Production should pull the annual State Council notice.
